sharedFindings: five recovery/migration families already provide no-write preview, explicit exact approval, deterministic target hashes, authoritative reread, and preservation receipts
those five families use operation-specific React state and receipts and do not enter the generic ProposalBatch envelope or append-only lifecycle history
ordinary create/save/save-as/rename, asset import, and add-Scene paths remain direct mutating commands without a generic preview
the existing desktop proposal session is Scene-target-keyed and cannot safely host project-operation targets without a later explicit session generalization
raw asset bytes must remain outside generic command/history persistence even when an asset operation is normalized
